title: OpenRouter and LiteLLM
summary: Two API gateways that reach many models with one address and key. They only answer with text, so Jev uses them for questions, analysis, review and planning. With Approve MCP servers on, they can also use your MCP servers' tools.
usage: In Settings › OpenRouter or LiteLLM, enter the base URL and the API key (OpenRouter: openrouter.ai/api/v1; LiteLLM: your proxy, such as http://localhost:4000/v1, key optional). Turn it on, save, then click Check connection and load the models. The key stays on this computer. Organizations can allow or block each one in the LLM policy.
